description: Off-white and tan cotton overshirts on a black hanging rail against a plain grey wall; garments sit on the right, calm empty wall on the left for text.
Studio shot on a soft lilac backdrop: model seated on a wooden stool in a camel blazer, white top and light-wash jeans.
Three models in white and beige shirts and utility jackets against a light grey studio wall; neutral new-collection mood.
Bright boutique rail of beige, peach and rust dresses and blouses on rose-gold hangers by a window with a plant (cropped to remove a wall dispenser).
Flat lay on white: tortoiseshell and clear hoop earrings, a woven rectangular earring, round sunglasses and an orange-and-white silk scarf.
Model seated on the floor in a khaki short-sleeve utility shirt and matching trousers against a sand-yellow studio wall.
Model by a window in a long beige trench coat worn open over a white crop top and beige drawstring trousers.
Model in a camel wool longline coat, beige outfit and wide-brim hat standing in a white colonnade.
Small warm-lit atelier: a maker marks black fabric at a cutting table beside a sewing machine, dress form and rail of finished pieces; figure seen at a distance.
Two folded crew-neck T-shirts, one white and one black, on a plain white surface.
Close-up of off-white linen button-up shirts on wooden hangers showing collars and texture.
Heather-grey hoodie close-up with white drawcords, hands adjusting the cord; no face.
Rail of brown, tan and black leather jackets in a bright boutique with a mirror and white curtains.
Stack of folded jeans in light to dark indigo washes on a wooden cane chair against a white wall.
Black slip dresses, a sequin dress and an olive dress on gold hangers on a black rail before cream curtains.
Pair of brown leather lace-up derby shoes, top view on a white background.
Green structured leather top-handle tote resting on a blush-pink leather bag, white studio background.
Flat lay on coral: black-strap analog watch with white dial, clear aviator glasses and a fine gold chain.
Top view on a beige surface: silver laptop corner, black smartphone and a white charger with cable; wide empty space on the right for text.
